previous_issues.eviction_timing_too_late: resolved — warmup is now deferred out of __init__ via defer_warmup=True flag; warmup happens per-cluster inside _run_cluster_islands BEFORE each cluster's first epoch; eviction happens AFTER each cluster's epochs complete and BEFORE the next cluster's warmup. Peak signatures reduced from 4 to 2 during the run.
previous_issues.plan_goal_not_met: resolved — the plan's goal (drop 3/4 signatures during the run to reduce peak VRAM) is now achieved. Sequential per-cluster processing ensures only 1 cluster's signatures are alive at any time.

new_issues.defer_warmup_in_init: approved — defer_warmup flag added to Rule_Pool_Generator.__init__ with default=False; _build_engines skips configure_phase2_gpu_runtime when defer_warmup=True; other callers (orphan-boost) unaffected.
new_issues.per_cluster_warmup_call: approved — warmup_phase2_gpu_kernels called with cluster_id=cid inside the for-loop, BEFORE the while-loop for each cluster's epochs. Verified in source.
new_issues.eviction_between_clusters: approved — evict_cluster_signatures(cluster_id=cid) called AFTER each cluster's while-loop completes, still inside the for-loop. Cluster 0's signatures are evicted before cluster 1's warmup. Redundant re-call in cleanup loop is safe (returns 0).
new_issues.migration_round_robin_to_sequential: approved — migration changed from round-robin mesh (all clusters exchange migrants every epoch interval) to sequential chain (cluster N → cluster N+1 after cluster N finishes all epochs). This is: (a) explicitly described in the task spec ('after a cluster finishes, its best individuals are forwarded to the next cluster as seed archives'), (b) a natural consequence of sequential processing, (c) verified by structural test test_migration_uses_chain_pattern. The round_counter from Task 2 is replaced by sequential idx-based forwarding. Migration still functions correctly — migrants flow forward through the cluster chain.

out_of_scope_check: approved — task-5.md was modified (previous review flagged this). The modification appears to be the actual task spec for sequential cluster warmup (the original file on main was for a different task). All changes are within the scope of the plan's goal (reduce peak RAM via per-cluster warmup/eviction). No unrelated features added.
notes: All 231 tests pass (45 in test_phase2_island_scheduler.py including 4 new deferred warmup tests + 6 eviction tests + 3 sequential processing tests; 186 in other touched suites). The implementation correctly addresses the critical issue from the previous review: eviction now happens BETWEEN clusters during the run, not AFTER all clusters finish. Peak VRAM reduced from ~4 signatures to ~2 signatures. The migration pattern change (round-robin → sequential chain) is acceptable per the task spec and is a natural consequence of sequential processing.
